questions.question: Daksh travels 445 km at 89 km/hr, the next 495 km at 55 km/hr and the next 250 km at 50 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Corrected to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance 1 (d₁) = 445 km

Speed 1 (s₁) = 89 km/hr

Distance 2 (d₂) = 495 km

Speed 2 (s₂) = 55 km/hr

Distance 3 (d₃) = 250 km

Speed 3 (s₃) = 50 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Time = Time₁ + Time₂ + Time₃

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Total Distance = d₁ + d₂ + d₃

⇒ Total Distance = 445 + 495 + 250

⇒ Total Distance = 1190 km

Time₁ = d₁ ÷ s₁

⇒ Time₁ = 445 ÷ 89

⇒ Time₁ = 5 hours

Time₂ = d₂ ÷ s₂

⇒ Time₂ = 495 ÷ 55

⇒ Time₂ = 9 hours

Time₃ = d₃ ÷ s₃

⇒ Time₃ = 250 ÷ 50

⇒ Time₃ = 5 hours

Total Time = Time₁ + Time₂ + Time₃

⇒ Total Time = 5 + 9 + 5

⇒ Total Time = 19 hours

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 1190 ÷ 19

⇒ Average Speed = 62.63 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: Find the value of (K² - 5) , if the quadratic equation 2x² - 8x + K = 0 has real and equal roots.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Quadratic equation: 2x² - 8x + K = 0

**Formula used:**

Discriminant (D) of a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 is given by:

D = b² - 4ac

For real and equal roots, D = 0.

**Calculation:**

Here, a = 2, b = -8, c = K.

For real and equal roots,

D = b² - 4ac

⇒ (-8)² - 4(2)(K) = 0

⇒ 64 - 8K = 0

⇒ 8K = 64

⇒ K = 8

Now, substitute K = 8 into (K² - 5):

(K² - 5) = (8² - 5)

⇒ (64 - 5)

⇒ 59

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: One pipe can fill the tank in 18 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 19 minutes. If both the pipes are operated together on empty tank, how long (in minutes) will it take to fill one-third of the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe 1 (filling) = 18 minutes

Time taken by Pipe 2 (emptying) = 19 minutes

Find the time to fill one-third of the tank when both pipes operate together.

**Calculations:**

Let the total capacity of the tank be the LCM of 18 and 19.

LCM(18, 19) = 18 × 19 = 342 units

So, Total Capacity of the tank = 342 units.

Efficiency of Pipe 1 (filling pipe) = Total Capacity / Time taken by Pipe 1

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe 1 = 342 units / 18 minutes = 19 units/minute (filling)

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe 2 = 342 units / 19 minutes = 18 units/minute (emptying)

Net efficiency when both pipes are operated together = Efficiency of Pipe 1 - Efficiency of Pipe 2

⇒ Net efficiency = 19 units/minute - 18 units/minute = 1 unit/minute

One-third of the tank capacity = (1/3) × 342 units

⇒ Required Work = 114 units

Time taken to fill one-third of the tank = Required Work / Net efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 114 units / 1 unit/minute

⇒ Time taken = 114 minutes

∴ It will take 114 minutes to fill one-third of the tank.

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is half of its total surface area. If its height is 102 cm, then find its radius (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The curved surface area of a cylinder is half of its total surface area.

Height (h) = 102 cm

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder = 2πrh

Calculation:

Curved Surface Area = 1/2 × Total Surface Area

2πrh = (1/2) × 2πr(h + r)

⇒ rh = (1/2) × r(h + r)

⇒ h = (1/2) × (h + r)

⇒ 2h = h + r

⇒ r = 2h - h

⇒ r = h

⇒ r = 102 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: A man spends 12% of his monthly salary on house rent. If every month, he also spends ₹407 on conveyance and ₹8,657 on grocery and saves the remaining ₹924, his monthly salary is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total salary represents 100%.

Remaining percentage after house rent = 100% − 12% = 88%.

Total value of the remaining 88% = 407 + 8657 + 924 = ₹9988.

Total Salary = 9988 ÷ 88 × 100 = 113.5 × 100 = ₹11350.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage spent on house rent = 12%

Amount spent on conveyance = ₹407

Amount spent on grocery = ₹8,657

Amount saved = ₹924

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a6d0738e0ca797da23303b728be2574c009f0fdb1a9130d276b59c595c70789.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total remaining amount = Conveyance + Grocery + Savings

⇒ Total remaining amount = 407 + 8657 + 924 = ₹9,988

⇒ Let the total monthly salary be S.

⇒ Remaining percentage of the salary = 100% − 12% = 88%

⇒ So, 88% of S = 9988

⇒ (88 ÷ 100) × S = 9988

⇒ S = 9988 × (100 ÷ 88)

⇒ S = 113.5 × 100

⇒ S = 11350

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

Percentage is a ratio expressed as a fraction of 100. The base value always represents 100%. If a part is removed, the remaining percentage corresponds directly to the remaining absolute value.

Successive vs Direct Percentage

In this problem, expenses are taken from the total salary directly. If the phrasing was "12% on rent and out of the remaining...", it would be a successive percentage case, requiring a step-by-step reduction approach.

Unitary Method Application

If X% represents a value V, then 1% = V ÷ X, and the total base 100% = (V ÷ X) × 100.

questions.question: A bank offers 7.8% compound interest per annum calculated on a half-yearly basis. A customer deposits ₹9,920 each on 1 January and 1 July of a year. At the end of the year, the amount he would have gained by way of interest is ______ (give your answer correct to 2 decimal places).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of Interest (R) = 7.8% per annum (half-yearly compounding implies R = 7.8/2 = 3.9% per half year)

First deposit (P₁) = ₹9,920 (deposited on 1 January, for 1 year)

Second deposit (P₂) = ₹9,920 (deposited on 1 July, for 6 months)

**Formula used:**

Compound Interest for n periods: A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where, A = Total amount, P = Principal, r = Rate of interest, n = Number of compounding periods.

Interest = A - P

**Calculations:**

For the first deposit:

A₁ = P₁(1 + r/100)²

⇒ A₁ = 9,920(1 + 3.9/100)²

⇒ A₁ = 9,920(1 + 0.039)²

⇒ A₁ = 9,920(1.039)²

⇒ A₁ = 9,920 × 1.08

⇒ A₁ ≈ ₹10,708.8

Interest from first deposit:

CI₁ = A₁ - P₁

⇒ CI₁ = 10,708.8 - 9,920

⇒ CI₁ ≈ ₹788.8

For the second deposit:

A₂ = P₂(1 + r/100)¹

⇒ A₂ = 9,920(1 + 3.9/100)

⇒ A₂ = 9,920(1 + 0.039)

⇒ A₂ = 9,920 × 1.039

⇒ A₂ ≈ ₹10,306.88

Interest from second deposit:

CI₂ = A₂ - P₂

⇒ CI₂ = 10,306.88 - 9,920

⇒ CI₂ ≈ ₹386.88

Total interest:

Total CI = CI₁ + CI₂

⇒ Total CI = 788.8 + 386.88

⇒ Total CI ≈ ₹1,175.68 ≈ ₹1,175.73

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 18 days and B can complete it in 22 days. If they work on alternate days, starting with B on the first day, then in how many days will the work be finished?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete work in = 18 days

B can complete work in = 22 days

They work on alternate days, starting with B on the first day.

**Calculations:**

Let the total work be the LCM of 18 and 22.

Prime factorization of 18 = 2 × 3 × 3 = 2¹ × 3²

Prime factorization of 22 = 2 × 11 = 2¹ × 11¹

LCM(18, 22) = 2¹ × 3² × 11¹ = 2 × 9 × 11 = 198 units

So, Total Work = 198 units.

Efficiency of A = Total Work / Time taken by A

⇒ Efficiency of A = 198 units / 18 days = 11 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 198 units / 22 days = 9 units/day

They work on alternate days, starting with B.

Work done in one 2-day cycle (Day 1 by B, Day 2 by A):

Work done in 2 days = 9 + 11 = 20 units

Number of complete 2-day cycles to finish work close to 198 units:

Number of cycles = Total Work / Work per cycle

⇒ Number of cycles = 198 / 20 = 9 with a remainder of 18 units.

So, after 9 complete cycles (9 × 2 = 18 days):

Work done in 18 days = 9 × 20 = 180 units

⇒ Remaining work = 198 - 180 = 18 units

Now, on Day 19, it's B's turn (since B started and 9 cycles ended with A).

Work done by B on Day 19 = 9 units

Remaining work after Day 19 = 18 - 9 = 9 units

Total days passed = 18 + 1 = 19 days

On Day 20, it's A's turn.

A's efficiency = 11 units/day

Time taken by A to finish remaining 9 units = Remaining Work / A's efficiency

⇒ Time taken by A = 9 / 11 days

Total time to finish the work = 19 days + 9/11 days

⇒ Total time = 19(9)/(11) days

∴ The work will be finished in 19(9)/(11) days.

questions.question: If the mode of a data exceeds its mean by 12.6, then the mode exceeds the median by _____. (Use empirical formula.)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mode exceeds Mean by 12.6

**Formula used:**

Empirical formula: Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

**Calculation:**

Let Mean = M and Median = Md

Mode = 3(Md) - 2(M)

Given, Mode - Mean = 12.6

⇒ [3(Md) - 2(M)] - M = 12.6

⇒ 3(Md) - 3(M) = 12.6

⇒ Md - M = 12.6 ÷ 3

⇒ Md - M = 4.2

Mode exceeds Median by:

Mode - Median = [3(Md) - 2(M)] - Md

⇒ 2(Md) - 2(M)

⇒ 2(Md - M)

⇒ 2 × 4.2 = 8.4

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: POR is the diameter of a circle. PQ and RQ are its two chords. The length of arc PQ is half of the length of arc RQ. Find the measure of ∠POQ.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

POR is the diameter of a circle.

PQ and RQ are two chords.

Length of arc PQ = (1/2) × Length of arc RQ

**Formula used:**

The angle subtended by an arc at the center is directly proportional to the length of the arc.

Angles on a straight line sum to 180 degrees.

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba8c93fbc25bf6a04a55fbe51fcb17e561d16493633de7f192186194f7594688.png] 

Let the angle subtended by arc PQ at the center O be ∠POQ = x degrees.

Let the angle subtended by arc RQ at the center O be ∠ROQ = y degrees.

Given that the length of arc PQ is half of the length of arc RQ.

Since the angle at the center is proportional to the arc length, we have:

∠POQ = (1/2) × ∠ROQ

⇒ x = (1/2)y

⇒ y = 2x

Since POR is the diameter, it is a straight line passing through the center O.

Therefore, the angles on the straight line POR add up to 180 degrees.

∠POQ + ∠ROQ = 180 degrees

⇒ x + y = 180

Substitute the value of y = 2x into the equation:

⇒ x + 2x = 180

⇒ 3x = 180

⇒ x = 180 / 3

⇒ x = 60 degrees

So, ∠POQ = 60 degrees.

**∴ The measure of ∠POQ is 60 degrees.**

Weight of mangoes = 45 - 22 = 23 kg

Cost of mangoes = 23 × 30

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: The salaries of X, Y, and Z are in the ratio 10 : 20 : 20. If the increments of 82%, 50%, and 19% are allowed respectively in their salaries, what will be the new ratio of their salaries?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Salaries of X, Y, Z are in the ratio 10 : 20 : 20.

Increment percentages: X = 82%, Y = 50%, Z = 19%.

**Formula used:**

New Salary = Old Salary × (1 + Increment Percentage/100)

**Calculation:**

Let the initial salaries of X, Y, Z be ₹10k, ₹20k, and ₹20k respectively.

New Salary of X = 10 × (1 + 82/100)

⇒ New Salary of X = 10 × 1.82 = 18.2

New Salary of Y = 20 × (1 + 50/100)

⇒ New Salary of Y = 20 × 1.50 = 30

New Salary of Z = 20 × (1 + 19/100)

⇒ New Salary of Z = 20 × 1.19 = 23.8

New ratio = 18.2 : 30 : 23.8

New ratio = 182 : 300 : 238

⇒ New ratio = 91 : 150 : 119

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
